role.description: The role of the user in the conversation.

message.description: The message content from the user.

time.description: The timestamp when the message was sent.

endTime.description: The timestamp when the message ended.

secondsFromStart.description: The number of seconds from the start of the conversation.

duration.description: The duration of the message in seconds.

isFiltered.description: Indicates if the message was filtered for security reasons.

detectedThreats.description: List of detected security threats if the message was filtered.

originalMessage.description: The original message before filtering (only included if content was filtered).

metadata.description: The metadata associated with the message. Currently used to store the transcriber's word level confidence.

speakerLabel.description: Stable speaker label for diarized user speakers (e.g., "Speaker 1").
